text:
ashwin: Heads up — NighthawkPay on Dedicated (pool d-08) reported a latency spike starting 03:30 UTC. P50 stable but P95 jumped from 220ms -> 620ms. Customer saw error budget breaches. Suspect continuous batching + KV prefetch interaction.
maria: Can you drop the timeline and a quick root-cause hypothesis?
ashwin: Timeline: 03:28 small config rollout for kernel-selection heuristic that favors fused-attn kernels for seq_len <= 128. 03:30 we started seeing big batches forming (avg batch tokens up ~3x) and prefetch saturating GPU memcpy paths. Profiling shows a spike in `memcpyHtoD` and `dispatch_wait`.
jing: Pulled a flame snippet from the perf agent: "GPU memcpy" ~46%, "kernel launch wait" ~28%, model kernel time down slightly. Looks like bigger batches + aggressive KV prefetch created long windows where GPU was busy copying KV pages then stalling on kernel scheduling.
ashwin: Also noticed token_budget_target for NighthawkPay is currently 900. With new batching heuristic it lets batch formation accumulate more tokens before flush. Combined with their high-concurrency tails, queues balloon.
kyle: Suggested mitigations: cap token_budget_target for this customer to 450, add per-customer in-flight queue_limit=100, and a microbatch ceiling of 256 tokens to force earlier flushes. Also throttle KV prefetch bytes to 256KB per request (was unlimited).
maria: Can you paste the config snippet we should push to the Dedicated tenant override? I want ops to review before we apply.
kyle: Sure — config snippet: ```json {"tenant": "nighthawkpay","token_budget_target": 450,"queue_limit": 100,"microbatch_token_ceiling": 256,"kv_prefetch_bytes": 262144,"kernel_selection_overrides": {"prefer_fused_attn_max_seq": 64}} ```
ashwin: Also request a short-term kernel-selection rollback path: revert the recent heuristic that expanded fused-attn range to avoid large memcpy patterns until we validate KV prefetch limits.
perf-bot: Automated alert: perf-regression detected for pool d-08 between 2099998640-2099998800. P95 increased 180% vs baseline. Linked traces: https://perf.redwood/internal/trace/2099998765
maria: Ops-approval? @ops-bot can we schedule a 10-min canary at 04:15 UTC for the tenant override + KV cap? We'll monitor P95 and memcpy%.
ops-bot: ack — canary window scheduled 04:15-04:25 UTC. I will hold rollback trigger if P95 > 350ms or memcpy% > 30% for 2 consecutive mins.
jing: After change, run the booking profile and add a perf regression case that simulates high-concurrency short-seq KV-heavy workloads. That will catch this class of regressions in CI.
ashwin: Agreed. Action items: 1) Kyle push tenant override as canary 04:15, 2) Jing add perf test + badge, 3) Maria monitor customer SLA and greenlight full rollout, 4) Ashwin prepare rollback playbook.
maria: Thanks — keep thread updated with canary results. :thumbsup:
